title: Was Taj Mahal originally a Shiva temple? Allahabad HC asks Centre, ASI to respond on plea to inspect monument
description: A plea has been filed before the Allahabad High Court seeking the appointment of an Advocate Commissioner to inspect and photograph the Taj Mahal, in connection with a pending civil suit claiming that the monument was originally the Tejo Mahalaya, a Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiva.Justice Rohit Ranjan Agarwal on Monday sought responses in the matter from the Union government and the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI), and directed them to file their counter-affidavits. Justice Rohit
